description: One of the person’s connected games, from Roblox’s own analytics: daily active users (30-day average, and the 30 days before), monthly active users, playtime per daily user, session length, Day 1, 7 and 30 retention and, unless they’re only a guest on it, the share of players who pay and Robux (last 30 days, a day, per daily user, per paying user); each with where it sits among similar games (Roblox’s benchmarks), and players from Roblox’s ads against everyone else when their plan has it. Private: only games my_games says are theirs to read.
